description:
Join our Finance Operations team and contribute to accurate financial reporting, account reconciliations, and closing activities. You will help maintain data integrity, support process improvements, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality financial services.

 

Job location

Bucharest or Brasov, fully office-based for the first 6 months, followed by a hybrid setup. Monday to Friday, 09:00–18:00.

 

Your mission

 

  • Prepare and maintain accurate financial information in line with reporting requirements;
  • Perform account analyses and reconciliations while ensuring ownership of the standard chart of accounts;
  • Support month-end and year-end closing activities in compliance with internal controls and accounting standards;
  • Identify and resolve discrepancies through preventive quality controls and corrective actions;
  • Contribute to process improvement initiatives that enhance efficiency and accuracy.

 

Required Qualifications

 

  • Hungarian & English - B2;
  • High school diploma;
  • Minimum 1 year experience in finance roles such as General Ledger, Record to Report;
  • Ability to communicate effectively and collaborate within a team environment;
  • Ability to manage urgent matters with a proactive and reliable approach.

 

Preferred Qualifications

 

  • Bachelor’s degree;
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams;
  • Experience supporting coordination activities and providing team guidance when required;
  • Continuous improvement mindset and interest in process optimization.

 

Employee Benefits – Be well, work well, live well

 

  • Private medical and dental coverage through Regina Maria.
  • Flexible benefits package via Benefit Online, including vouchers, transportation, wellness, and cultural activities.
  • 23 vacation days, with additional days awarded through our loyalty program.
  • Additional private pension plan starting from the second month of employment.
  • Access to extensive learning, training, and career development opportunities.
  • Well-being support, including psychological counseling and premium wellness apps.
  • Life insurance coverage for you and your loved ones.
  • Flexible working hours, depending on project requirements.

 

Discover the full range of Accenture benefits here: Employee Benefits at Accenture
